n.no: User-facing caller for unique id generator.
Distribute incoming connections across healthy instances for unique id generator.

Two ticket servers allocate disjoint odd/even counter ranges using transactional high-water marks. Worker IDs are implicit in the disjoint namespace. Range allocation is monotonic, but local consumption is not timestamp ordered; clock skew does not affect uniqueness.
Allocate disjoint ranges atomically; lost ranges create gaps and must never be reused.

apis.note: Serialize 64-bit integers as strings in JSON. Library mode calls this locally; UUIDv7 returns 128-bit values and requires a relaxed ID-width requirement.
